  to_char(date_trunc('month', submitted_at), 'YYYY-MM') as month,
  count(*) as csat_responses,
  round(avg(score)::numeric, 2) as avg_score,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by score)::numeric, 1) as median_score,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when score >= 4 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_satisfied,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when score <= 2 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_dissatisfied
from csat_responses
where submitted_at >= timestamp '2023-01-01' and submitted_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
